The cradle supports it from below without blocking\n    drop-in from above.\n\n    pole_diameter: diameter of the pole (mm)\n    \"\"\"\n\n    pole_radius = pole_diameter / 2.0\n    pole_center_z = 18.0\n\n    # Cradle geometry: semicircular support with controlled clearance\n    # Inner radius provides 0.1 mm clearance from pole surface\n    # Outer radius adds 1.2 mm of material thickness behind contact point\n    inner_radius = pole_radius + 0.1  # 10.1 mm for 20 mm pole\n    outer_radius = inner_radius + 1.2  # 11.3 mm\n\n    # Base platform (sits flat on bed)\n    base_width = 32  # X direction\n    base_length = 60  # Y direction (along pole axis)\n    base_height = 3  # Z direction\n    base = box(base_width, base_length, base_height)\n\n    # Cylindrical shell for cradle (centered at pole height)\n    outer_cyl = cylinder(outer_radius, base_length).translate([0, 0, pole_center_z])\n    inner_cyl = cylinder(inner_radius, base_length).translate([0, 0, pole_center_z])\n\n    # Shell: outer cylinder minus inner void\n    shell = outer_cyl - inner_cyl\n\n    # Cut away upper hemisphere to create open cradle\n    # This allows pole to drop in from above and exposes support arc\n    upper_cut = box(1000, base_length, 1000).translate([0, 0, pole_center_z])\n    cradle = shell - upper_cut\n\n    # Combine base and cradle\n    part = base | cradle\n\n    # Polish edges for smooth appearance\n    part = part.chamfer_edges(1.0)\n\n    return part\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":8,"cache_creation_input_tokens":234,"cache_read_input_tokens":39477,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":234},"output_tokens":1,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"cf77ea48-da39-4376-b36f-f8da3db27ea7","uuid":"80bce3df-e26c-4e2a-87a7-e6d4eadfb6d9","timestamp":"2026-08-24T00:42:02.883Z","request_id":"req_011CeLeLaAbkkHUgcacSuqoX"}

The cradle supports it from below without blocking\n    drop-in from above.\n\n    pole_diameter: diameter of the pole (mm)\n    \"\"\"\n\n    pole_radius = pole_diameter / 2.0\n    pole_center_z = 18.0\n\n    # Cradle geometry: semicircular support with controlled clearance\n    # Inner radius provides 0.1 mm clearance from pole surface\n    # Outer radius adds 1.2 mm of material thickness behind contact point\n    inner_radius = pole_radius + 0.1  # 10.1 mm for 20 mm pole\n    outer_radius = inner_radius + 1.2  # 11.3 mm\n\n    # Base platform (sits flat on bed)\n    base_width = 32  # X direction\n    base_length = 60  # Y direction (along pole axis)\n    base_height = 3  # Z direction\n    base = box(base_width, base_length, base_height)\n\n    # Cylindrical shell for cradle (centered at pole height)\n    outer_cyl = cylinder(outer_radius, base_length).translate([0, 0, pole_center_z])\n    inner_cyl = cylinder(inner_radius, base_length).translate([0, 0, pole_center_z])\n\n    # Shell: outer cylinder minus inner void\n    shell = outer_cyl - inner_cyl\n\n    # Cut away upper hemisphere to create open cradle\n    # This allows pole to drop in from above and exposes support arc\n    upper_cut = box(1000, base_length, 1000).translate([0, 0, pole_center_z])\n    cradle = shell - upper_cut\n\n    # Combine base and cradle\n    part = base | cradle\n\n    # Polish edges for smooth appearance\n    part = part.chamfer_edges(1.0)\n\n    return part\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":1,"oldLines":4,"newStart":1,"newLines":4,"lines":["-from nurbs_cad import box, cylinder","+from nurb import *"," "," def pole_rest(pole_diameter=20.0):","     \"\"\""]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false}}

The cradle supports it from below without blocking\n    drop-in from above.\n\n    pole_diameter: diameter of the pole (mm)\n    \"\"\"\n\n    pole_radius = pole_diameter / 2.0\n    pole_center_z = 18.0\n\n    # Cradle geometry: semicircular support with controlled clearance\n    # Inner radius provides 0.1 mm clearance from pole surface\n    # Outer radius adds 1.2 mm of material thickness behind contact point\n    inner_radius = pole_radius + 0.1  # 10.1 mm for 20 mm pole\n    outer_radius = inner_radius + 1.2  # 11.3 mm\n\n    # Base platform (sits flat on bed)\n    base_width = 32  # X direction\n    base_length = 60  # Y direction (along pole axis)\n    base_height = 3  # Z direction\n    base = Box(base_width, base_length, base_height)\n\n    # Cylindrical shell for cradle (centered at pole height)\n    outer_cyl = Cylinder(outer_radius, base_length).translate((0, 0, pole_center_z))\n    inner_cyl = Cylinder(inner_radius, base_length).translate((0, 0, pole_center_z))\n\n    # Shell: outer cylinder minus inner void\n    shell = outer_cyl - inner_cyl\n\n    # Cut away upper hemisphere to create open cradle\n    # This allows pole to drop in from above and exposes support arc\n    upper_cut = Box(1000, base_length, 1000).translate((0, 0, pole_center_z))\n    cradle = shell - upper_cut\n\n    # Combine base and cradle\n    part = base | cradle\n\n    # Polish edges for smooth appearance\n    part = part.chamfer_edges(1.0)\n\n    return part\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":39,"oldLines":7,"newStart":39,"newLines":7,"lines":["     cradle = shell - upper_cut"," ","     # Combine base and cradle","-    part = base | cradle","+    part = base.union(cradle)"," ","     # Polish edges for smooth appearance","     part = part.chamfer_edges(1.0)"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false}}

The cradle supports it from below without blocking\n    drop-in from above.\n\n    pole_diameter: diameter of the pole (mm)\n    \"\"\"\n\n    pole_radius = pole_diameter / 2.0\n    pole_center_z = 18.0\n\n    # Cradle geometry: semicircular support with controlled clearance\n    # Inner radius provides 0.1 mm clearance from pole surface\n    # Outer radius adds 1.2 mm of material thickness behind contact point\n    inner_radius = pole_radius + 0.1  # 10.1 mm for 20 mm pole\n    outer_radius = inner_radius + 1.2  # 11.3 mm\n\n    # Base platform (sits flat on bed)\n    base_width = 32  # X direction\n    base_length = 60  # Y direction (along pole axis)\n    base_height = 3  # Z direction\n    base = Box(base_width, base_length, base_height)\n\n    # Cylindrical shell for cradle (centered at pole height)\n    outer_cyl = Cylinder(outer_radius, base_length).translate((0, 0, pole_center_z))\n    inner_cyl = Cylinder(inner_radius, base_length).translate((0, 0, pole_center_z))\n\n    # Shell: outer cylinder minus inner void\n    shell = outer_cyl - inner_cyl\n\n    # Cut away upper hemisphere to create open cradle\n    # This allows pole to drop in from above and exposes support arc\n    upper_cut = Box(1000, base_length, 1000).translate((0, 0, pole_center_z))\n    cradle = shell - upper_cut\n\n    # Combine base and cradle using addition\n    part = base + cradle\n\n    # Polish edges for smooth appearance\n    part = polish(part, concave_edges(part), 1.0)\n\n    return part\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":38,"oldLines":10,"newStart":38,"newLines":7,"lines":["     upper_cut = Box(1000, base_length, 1000).translate((0, 0, pole_center_z))","     cradle = shell - upper_cut"," ","-    # Combine base and cradle using addition","+    # Combine base and cradle","     part = base + cradle"," ","-    # Polish edges for smooth appearance","-    part = polish(part, concave_edges(part), 1.0)","-","     return part"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false}}

The cradle supports it from below without blocking\n    drop-in from above.\n\n    pole_diameter: diameter of the pole (mm)\n    \"\"\"\n\n    pole_radius = pole_diameter / 2.0\n    pole_center_z = 18.0\n\n    # Cradle geometry: semicircular support with controlled clearance\n    # Inner radius provides 0.1 mm clearance from pole surface\n    # Outer radius adds 1.2 mm of material thickness behind contact point\n    inner_radius = pole_radius + 0.1  # 10.1 mm for 20 mm pole\n    outer_radius = inner_radius + 1.2  # 11.3 mm\n\n    # Base platform (sits flat on bed)\n    base_width = 32  # X direction\n    base_length = 60  # Y direction (along pole axis)\n    base_height = 3  # Z direction\n    base = Box(base_width, base_length, base_height)\n\n    # Cylindrical shell for cradle (centered at pole height)\n    outer_cyl = Cylinder(outer_radius, base_length).translate((0, 0, pole_center_z))\n    inner_cyl = Cylinder(inner_radius, base_length).translate((0, 0, pole_center_z))\n\n    # Shell: outer cylinder minus inner void\n    shell = outer_cyl - inner_cyl\n\n    # Cut away upper hemisphere to create open cradle\n    # This allows pole to drop in from above and exposes support arc\n    upper_cut = Box(1000, base_length, 1000).translate((0, 0, pole_center_z))\n    cradle = shell - upper_cut\n\n    # Combine base and cradle\n    part = base + cradle\n\n    return part","new_string":"from nurb import *\n\n@part\ndef pole_rest(pole_diameter=20.0):\n    \"\"\"\n    Cradle rest that holds a drying pole horizontally.\n    The pole's axis runs along Y at a fixed height (Z=18.0 mm) above the bed,\n    centered over the part. The cradle supports it from below without blocking\n    drop-in from above.\n\n    pole_diameter: diameter of the pole (mm)\n    \"\"\"\n\n    pole_radius = pole_diameter / 2.0\n    pole_center_z = 18.0\n\n    inner_radius = pole_radius + 0.1\n    outer_radius = inner_radius + 1.2\n\n    # Build base platform\n    base = Box(32, 60, 3)\n\n    # Build cradle shell\n    outer_cyl = Cylinder(outer_radius, 60).translate((0, 0, pole_center_z))\n    inner_cyl = Cylinder(inner_radius, 60).translate((0, 0, pole_center_z))\n\n    # Create cylindrical shell\n    shell = outer_cyl - inner_cyl\n\n    # Cut away upper hemisphere to create open cradle allowing drop-in\n    # Box positioned so it cuts from Z=18 upward\n    upper_cut = Box(1000, 60, 1000).translate((0, 0, 518))\n    cradle = shell - upper_cut\n\n    # Combine base and cradle\n    result = base.fuse(cradle)\n\n    return result\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":17,"oldLines":8,"newStart":17,"newLines":8,"lines":["     inner_radius = pole_radius + 0.1","     outer_radius = inner_radius + 1.2"," ","-    # Build base platform","-    base = Box(32, 60, 3)","+    # Build base platform (sits on bed at Z=0)","+    base = Box(32, 60, 3).translate((0, 0, 1.5))"," ","     # Build cradle shell","     outer_cyl = Cylinder(outer_radius, 60).translate((0, 0, pole_center_z))"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false}}

The cradle supports it from below without blocking\n    drop-in from above.\n\n    pole_diameter: diameter of the pole (mm)\n    \"\"\"\n\n    pole_radius = pole_diameter / 2.0\n    pole_center_z = 18.0\n\n    inner_radius = pole_radius + 0.1\n    outer_radius = inner_radius + 1.2\n\n    # Build base platform (sits on bed at Z=0)\n    base = Box(32, 60, 3).translate((0, 0, 1.5))\n\n    # Build cradle shell (cylinder height is 2x outer_radius for semicircular support)\n    cyl_height = outer_radius * 2.4  # ~23mm for 20mm pole\n    outer_cyl = Cylinder(outer_radius, cyl_height).translate((0, 0, pole_center_z))\n    inner_cyl = Cylinder(inner_radius, cyl_height).translate((0, 0, pole_center_z))\n\n    # Create cylindrical shell\n    shell = outer_cyl - inner_cyl\n\n    # Cut away upper hemisphere to create open cradle allowing drop-in\n    # Box positioned so it cuts from Z=pole_center_z upward\n    # Box default goes from -500,-30,-500 to 500,30,500, so translate Z by (500 + pole_center_z)\n    upper_cut = Box(1000, cyl_height, 1000).translate((0, 0, 500 + pole_center_z))\n    cradle = shell - upper_cut\n\n    # Combine base and cradle\n    result = base.fuse(cradle)\n\n    return result\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":17,"oldLines":8,"newStart":17,"newLines":8,"lines":["     inner_radius = pole_radius + 0.1","     outer_radius = inner_radius + 1.2"," ","-    # Build base platform (sits on bed at Z=0)","-    base = Box(32, 60, 3).translate((0, 0, 1.5))","+    # Build base platform (sits on bed at Z=0, extended to meet cradle)","+    base = Box(32, 60, 5).translate((0, 0, 2.5))"," ","     # Build cradle shell (cylinder height is 2x outer_radius for semicircular support)","     cyl_height = outer_radius * 2.4  # ~23mm for 20mm pole"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false}}

(file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"cf77ea48-da39-4376-b36f-f8da3db27ea7","uuid":"2f1f3bc1-7c7f-477e-a2a9-1650ba57a7d1","timestamp":"2026-08-24T00:49:57.368Z","tool_use_result":{"filePath":"/private/var/folders/s4/by90nw7j7_l_nvvqs3hd9mjh0000gn/T/nurb-eval-trial-ko9to0uh/project/parts/pole_rest.py","oldString":"    # Build base platform (sits on bed at Z=0, extended to meet cradle)\n    base = Box(32, 60, 5).translate((0, 0, 2.5))","newString":"    # Build base platform (sits on bed at Z=0, sized for volume efficiency)\n    # Base width must cover cradle (~22.6mm across), minimum footprint 200 mm², minimum Y 20mm\n    base = Box(26, 60, 3).translate((0, 0, 1.5))","originalFile":"from nurb import *\n\n@part\ndef pole_rest(pole_diameter=20.0):\n    \"\"\"\n    Cradle rest that holds a drying pole horizontally.\n    The pole's axis runs along Y at a fixed height (Z=18.0 mm) above the bed,\n    centered over the part. The cradle supports it from below without blocking\n    drop-in from above.\n\n    pole_diameter: diameter of the pole (mm)\n    \"\"\"\n\n    pole_radius = pole_diameter / 2.0\n    pole_center_z = 18.0\n\n    inner_radius = pole_radius + 0.1\n    outer_radius = inner_radius + 1.2\n\n    # Build base platform (sits on bed at Z=0, extended to meet cradle)\n    base = Box(32, 60, 5).translate((0, 0, 2.5))\n\n    # Build cradle shell (cylinder height is 2x outer_radius for semicircular support)\n    cyl_height = outer_radius * 2.4  # ~23mm for 20mm pole\n    outer_cyl = Cylinder(outer_radius, cyl_height).translate((0, 0, pole_center_z))\n    inner_cyl = Cylinder(inner_radius, cyl_height).translate((0, 0, pole_center_z))\n\n    # Create cylindrical shell\n    shell = outer_cyl - inner_cyl\n\n    # Cut away upper hemisphere to create open cradle allowing drop-in\n    # Box positioned so it cuts from Z=pole_center_z upward\n    # Box default goes from -500,-30,-500 to 500,30,500, so translate Z by (500 + pole_center_z)\n    upper_cut = Box(1000, cyl_height, 1000).translate((0, 0, 500 + pole_center_z))\n    cradle = shell - upper_cut\n\n    # Combine base and cradle\n    result = base.fuse(cradle)\n\n    return result\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":17,"oldLines":8,"newStart":17,"newLines":9,"lines":["     inner_radius = pole_radius + 0.1","     outer_radius = inner_radius + 1.2"," ","-    # Build base platform (sits on bed at Z=0, extended to meet cradle)","-    base = Box(32, 60, 5).translate((0, 0, 2.5))","+    # Build base platform (sits on bed at Z=0, sized for volume efficiency)","+    # Base width must cover cradle (~22.6mm across), minimum footprint 200 mm², minimum Y 20mm","+    base = Box(26, 60, 3).translate((0, 0, 1.5))"," ","     # Build cradle shell (cylinder height is 2x outer_radius for semicircular support)","     cyl_height = outer_radius * 2.4  # ~23mm for 20mm pole"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false}}

The cradle supports it from below without blocking\n    drop-in from above.\n\n    pole_diameter: diameter of the pole (mm)\n    \"\"\"\n\n    pole_radius = pole_diameter / 2.0\n    pole_center_z = 18.0\n\n    inner_radius = pole_radius + 0.1\n    outer_radius = inner_radius + 1.2\n\n    # Build base platform (sits on bed at Z=0, sized for volume efficiency)\n    # Base width must cover cradle (~22.6mm across), minimum footprint 200 mm², minimum Y 20mm\n    base = Box(26, 60, 3).translate((0, 0, 1.5))\n\n    # Build cradle shell (cylinder height is 2x outer_radius for semicircular support)\n    cyl_height = outer_radius * 2.4  # ~23mm for 20mm pole\n    outer_cyl = Cylinder(outer_radius, cyl_height).translate((0, 0, pole_center_z))\n    inner_cyl = Cylinder(inner_radius, cyl_height).translate((0, 0, pole_center_z))\n\n    # Create cylindrical shell\n    shell = outer_cyl - inner_cyl\n\n    # Cut away upper hemisphere to create open cradle allowing drop-in\n    # Box positioned so it cuts from Z=pole_center_z upward\n    upper_cut = Box(1000, 60, 1000).translate((0, 0, 500 + pole_center_z))\n    cradle = shell - upper_cut\n\n    # Combine base and cradle\n    result = base.fuse(cradle)\n\n    return result\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":19,"oldLines":7,"newStart":19,"newLines":8,"lines":[" ","     # Build base platform (sits on bed at Z=0, sized for volume efficiency)","     # Base width must cover cradle (~22.6mm across), minimum footprint 200 mm², minimum Y 20mm","-    base = Box(26, 60, 3).translate((0, 0, 1.5))","+    base_height = 4.5  # Must reach cradle bottom","+    base = Box(26, 60, base_height).translate((0, 0, base_height / 2))"," ","     # Build cradle shell (cylinder height is 2x outer_radius for semicircular support)","     cyl_height = outer_radius * 2.4  # ~23mm for 20mm pole"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false}}
